verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a physical consumer GPU that runs locally in the user's own machine. Choosing a cloud storage region or data residency is a hosted-service axis, so it does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offers any hosted storage service where a region could be chosen.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
